title: Passage and Escarpment
author: Wren Dravenmoor
blurb: Jonah Iversen, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
